text: OCTOBER 17, 2025
Chief Forensics Reporter
School Fire Call Came From the School's Own Lodge
The Call Came 14 Minutes Before the First Witness

The first call about the school fire came from the caretaker's lodge. No witness had seen the fire yet. In the evening, that line is the lodge telephone, not the `Main Office` one.

The school keeps a record of every badge read at every door. Detectives are checking every badge read on the evening of the 14th.
"Somebody was in that room at 20:58."

College Jean Moulin's own badge log: every badge, every door, on Monday 13 and Tuesday 14 October, up to the night of the fire. Doors: `Main Gate`, `Lodge`, `Science Wing`, `Library`, `Gym`, `Staff Room`, `Boiler Room`.
The *Last* Out
First the `Main Gate`, then the `Lodge`. Every door in `keycard_log` reads a badge going in. The `Main Gate` also reads it going out.

Whoever made the call was inside at 20:58. The last person to leave is the obvious suspect. Who left last on `2025-10-14`, through `Main Gate`? `ORDER BY at_time DESC` sorts from the latest to the earliest, and `LIMIT 1` keeps only the first row. Return one row: the name, the door and the time.
One row: a name, a door and a time.
Ruth Abasi, 21:19, 7 minutes after the flames were seen. Nobody went through the `Main Gate` after her. Now the `Lodge`, and who was in it at 20:58.
Before the *Call*
The 20:58 call was made from the `Lodge`. Its door reads every badge going in. The last one in before 20:58 was in the room.
Search `keycard_log` again. Who made that call? Return one row: that person's name and the time they went in.
One row: a name and the time they went in.
Victor Pell, 20:44. 14 minutes before the call. Bring him to the station and take his statement.
Check the doors in `keycard_log`. Somebody was in the `Lodge` when the call was made.
His *Statement*
Firefighters: the fire was started with white spirit, a paint thinner, probably from the `Boiler Room`.
Victor Pell's statement: that evening he went only to the `Gym`, then the `Science Wing`. Did he take the white spirit? Return the row from `keycard_log` that answers it: name, door, day and time.
One row: a name, a door, a day and a time.
The `Boiler Room` at 20:35. He named only the `Gym` and the `Science Wing`. He lied about where he went. Bring him back to the station.
Check all of Victor Pell's movements on the day of the fire, in `keycard_log`. One of them does not match his statement.
Flames at 21:12 → `dispatch_log` → one school fire call before it: 20:58, `LINE 4417`.
